charts.title: GJ 9827 c: orbits around GJ 9827
charts.description: The orbits of GJ 9827's planets in this map from above, to scale, with GJ 9827 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Kokori et al. 2023 (2023ApJS..265....4K), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname KOKORI_ET_AL__2023): P 3.6481145 d

charts.title: GJ 9827 c: its transit
charts.description: GJ 9827 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (42, 70, 92) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 301289516, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 26 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 26 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 26 min early; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 9 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
